换个条件，再看一次: Change a condition and look again
沙滩上的沙子从哪里来？: Where does beach sand come from?
跟着一粒小沙子，看岩石和贝壳怎样留下海边的颗粒。: Follow a grain and discover how rocks and shells supply beach sediment.
小小一粒沙，也有一段长旅行。: Even a tiny grain can have a long journey.
沙子按颗粒大小分类，常用地质粒径范围约为 0.0625–2 毫米。矿物组成并不唯: Sand is classified by grain size, commonly about 0.0625–2 mm in geology. Its composition varies: quartz is common, while many tropical beaches contain abundant biological carbonate grains. Not all sand passes through a river, and not every grain becomes rounded.
岩石路径和贝壳路径各展示一种可能经历，时间被大幅压缩。画面的金色不是所有沙滩的真: The rock and shell paths each show one possible history, with time greatly compressed. Golden sand is only one beach color; black and white sands also exist.
有的沙子来自岩石，有的来自贝壳、珊瑚等生物留下的硬结构。不同沙滩的来源可以很不一: Some sand comes from rock; some comes from hard biological material such as shells or coral. Beaches can have very different sources.
岩石会经历风化，贝壳也会破碎。得到的小颗粒有大有小，沙子只是其中一个大小范围。: Rock weathers and shells break. The fragments have many sizes; sand is one range of grain sizes.
河水、海浪和海流能搬运颗粒。有的颗粒走了很远，有的就在附近移动。: Rivers, waves and currents can move grains. Some travel far, while others stay nearby.
当搬运能力变弱时，一部分颗粒就会沉积。海浪还会把它们搬来搬去，沙滩一直在改变。: Some grains settle when water loses the ability to carry them. Waves can move them again, so beaches keep changing.
沙子有不同颜色和成分: Sand varies in color and composition
金色圈始终跟着同一粒；停下后仍留在沙滩: The gold ring follows one grain; it remains on the beach after settling
